name: hagenthon
description: Hagenthon — Inclusione Finanziaria. Root orchestrator per frontend Angular e backend Fastify.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix app/frontend install && npm --prefix app/backend install
